page.description: Upload, describe and manage the images and videos used in courses.
page.limits: Images up to {{image}}, videos up to {{video}} per file. Files are private: only the team and, later, enrolled members can access them. For videos, prefer MP4 (H.264): it is the format every browser and phone plays.

localized.englishInherits: The default image is shown in English.
localized.englishWhen: Only add one if the picture has to change in English (text, diagram, slide).
